corrected_value.authors: Thorpe, S. J., Patel, S. P. and Simonds, L. M.
corrected_value.title: The relationship between disgust sensitivity, anxiety and obsessions.

decisions.quote:
The relationship between DS and OCI-R subscale scores was examined. Thorpe et al.
(2003) found that DS was correlated with all OCI distress subscales, though most powerfully
with the washing distress subscale. In the present study, DS was significantly related to scores
on the washing, ordering and hoarding subscales but not to the three other subscale scores of
neutralizing, checking and obsessing, although the latter two subtype scores were close to a
significant relationship to DS.
decisions.reason: No prior adjudication or state files exist for this work. Beyond extending the Jones and Menzies (1997) behavioural avoidance task, the authors explicitly re-test the published questionnaire findings of Thorpe, Patel, and Simonds (2003, Behaviour Research and Therapy, 41, 1397–1409) in dedicated Results subsections examining (1) the relationships and mediation pattern among health anxiety, disgust sensitivity, and OCI-R washing distress scores and (2) the correlations between disgust sensitivity and all OCI-R distress subscales, directly comparing their observed correlations and mediation results against Thorpe et al. (2003). The sole shipped row (input_row_index 2446, 10.1016/s0005-7967(97)00035-1) is Jones and Menzies (1997; target_index 0), an independent 1997 study by different authors that did not examine disgust sensitivity or health anxiety.
